topic: A person's online friend turns out to live in the same city
text: Oh wow, I can't believe it, you're right here? In the same city? It's like... I don't know, I've been going through my head how this changes things. It's a big city, but it feels suddenly smaller. I mean, we've shared so much online, and now this? It's like stepping out into the unknown, even though part of me knows you better than anyone. It's a lot to process, and I guess I'm just not sure how to navigate this new space. What do you think? How do we make this work without losing what we already have? Does everything change now?
